rapport_notes: Patient and thorough with an unusual move type (69 potted plants), handled a string of anxious follow-up questions about timing without frustration.

evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: if moving your plants takes only two hours or less it's fine, but your final move could be more because of the long walk... so good thing I put in an allowance for two and a half to three and a half hours

top_strength: Handled a genuinely unusual move (69 potted plants from an event venue) with real flexibility — correctly determined a virtual walkthrough wasn't needed and adjusted the process on the fly.
coaching_note: When asked directly whether crews 'typically come on the later end of the window,' the answer wandered into an unrelated point about dishonest customers rather than a direct, reassuring answer — worth a cleaner stock response for that common question.
